chars.A: AMINE: an 18-year-old Moroccan young man with short black wavy hair, wearing a crisp white polo shirt with a navy collar, beige chinos and expensive white sneakers, gold watch.
chars.K: KHADIJA: an 18-year-old Moroccan young woman with dark hair in a low bun, round thin gold-framed glasses, wearing a faded lavender long cotton tunic with a grey knitted cardigan and plastic sandals.
chars.M: MOTHER: a Moroccan cleaning lady in her late 40s wearing a mint-green work smock over a long brown dress and a pink headscarf.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Comic moment in a bright private high school corridor in Rabat: KHADIJA has just accidentally splashed a full bucket of mop water onto AMINE's trousers; AMINE jumps back in shock with his arms up, his trousers soaking wet, while KHADIJA, holding the empty blue bucket, gasps with one hand over her mouth, mortified. Wet floor, mop on the floor.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: In a sunny school courtyard in Rabat, AMINE sits on a bench with his schoolbag, staring dreamily across the courtyard at KHADIJA, who is carrying a mop and bucket beside her MOTHER. AMINE has a lovestruck, determined expression.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: AMINE secretly peeks through the small glass window of a classroom door, while inside KHADIJA and her MOTHER wipe the desks and mop the floor. AMINE looks hesitant and hopeful.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: AMINE walks nervously down a long empty school corridor, rehearsing what to say, hand rubbing the back of his neck, worried and excited expression.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: In the same school corridor, AMINE suddenly comes face to face with KHADIJA who is mopping the shiny wet floor; both freeze in surprise, a little awkward, a yellow bucket between them.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: In the school corridor, AMINE grins and points at his own trousers as if reminding her of the water accident, while KHADIJA covers her face with both hands, blushing and laughing in embarrassment, holding her mop.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: AMINE and KHADIJA sit on the school stairs a little apart from each other, chatting; KHADIJA smiles shyly looking down, AMINE talks animatedly with his hands.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: On the school stairs KHADIJA looks away uncomfortably with her arms crossed, guarded, while AMINE scratches his head awkwardly, sensing the mood is off.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: In the school corridor AMINE stands in front of KHADIJA, hand on his chest, confessing his feelings with a nervous earnest face; KHADIJA stares back with wide shocked eyes behind her round glasses, holding her mop tight.
